Featured case study

Twice the premium.
A third less spend.

How I turned the company's main lead engine around after I took over in October 2025, then used it to open new sources of demand.

The problem

Growth ran on one channel: WhatsApp messages to our own database.

The same people got the same generic campaigns again and again. Each campaign cost more to get a reply, and premium stayed flat.

The insight

“The database wasn’t too small. We were saying the same thing to everyone in it.”

What I did

  1. 1

    Segment before you send

    Split every list by association, specialty and stage, so each message spoke to one audience.

  2. 2

    One message, one action

    Tested angles instead of copy tweaks, scaled the winners and retired formats once their cost per lead doubled.

  3. 3

    Sell to people who already trust us

    Gave existing customers their own cross-sell and renewal tracks instead of the same campaigns as everyone else.

What I learned

Before you buy more reach, fix what you’re saying to the reach you already have.
